name: Mitsu Chem Plast Limited
about: Mitsu Chem Plast Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures plastic blow and injection molded products in India and internationally. The company offers molded industrial packaging products, including pail containers, jerry cans, full open top drums, narrow mouth drums, containers, wide mouth drums or jars, agro chemicals and pharma packaging products, and bulk drugs and fine chemicals; diagnostic, cosmetics, and consumables products, as well as injection molded solutions. It also provides healthcare furniture products, such as curved head and leg bow, straight head and foot bow, grill head and foot bow, panel head and foot bow, side railing with bracket mechanism, over bed table top, bed board plank, bed side locker part, bed liner, spine board and stretcher, head immobilizer, plastic CPR board, buffer wheel, and plastic toilet seat products. In addition, the company offers infrastructural furniture products comprising plastic chair and seat shells, stadium and chair seats, chair parts, and baby car seat shells, as well as bus seats; and automotive components, such as tanks, snorkels, rainhood and air intakes, plastic pipes, and injection molded articles. Further, it provides medical devices, including pregnancy, malaria, and HIV kits, as well as inhalers. Mitsu Chem Plast Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Mumbai, India.
